messages.content: write a short conversation where someone asks about coffee, but the other person would like tea. keep both people kind.
would you like coffee? thank you, but could i have tea instead? yes. would you like milk in it? no milk, please. just tea is fine. i will bring it to the table.
now let the person ask for water because there is no tea.
would you like coffee? could i have tea instead? i am sorry, but i do not have tea today. water would be fine, thank you. would you like it now? yes, please.
does choosing water mean the person does not like coffee?
not from that conversation alone. they asked for tea and then water. they did not say how they feel about coffee in general.
can they still thank the person if they do not choose the first thing?
yes. they can thank someone for asking and choose something else. a kind reply does not have to be yes to the first choice.
give one short sentence for that.
thank you for asking, but water would be fine.
i want to ask a worker at the station whether this ticket is for the train i need. i am not sure it is right.
you could say: could you check whether this ticket is for the train to my stop?
i want a question that gives the worker the place i need. use town as the place for the example.
could you check whether this ticket is for the train to town, please?
what if there is more than one train to town?
then you may need to ask about the time or the station where you want to get off. the place alone may not give every detail needed for that ticket.
write a follow up asking about the next train.
can i use this ticket on the next train to town?
if the worker says no, should i say the ticket cannot be used for anything?
not always. it might work for a different time or a different journey. ask what it is for before choosing what to do next.
give me the question to ask.
which train can i use this ticket for?
i work at the table in my room. when i finish, it is hard to stop thinking about work because i am still sitting in the same place.
you could make a small change at the end of work, such as putting the work things away and moving to another chair. that gives you something different to do when work is over.
say it simply.
you can put your work things away when you finish. then choose something different to do, even if you stay in the same room.
i like listening to music. i could put the computer away and have music on.
that gives you a clear change in what you are doing. the table can be for work at one time and something you enjoy at another.
can you make a short plan with no specific hour?
finish the part you need to do. put the computer and work things away. choose some music and give yourself time without another work task.
what if i need the computer for the music too?
you could close the work you were doing and use the computer only for music for a while. you can use the same object for a different thing when work is over.
say the last idea simply.
you can use the same computer for a different thing after work. it does not need to leave the room for your task to change.
write a story where two children make a dance together. one starts with a step, and the other gives a new idea.

two children stand in a room with music playing. one takes a step to the left. the other takes a step to the right, then asks what comes next. they choose to turn around together. they try again and laugh when they do not turn together. then they slow down and say each part before doing it. by the end, they can do the short dance at the same time.
make the dance simple.

two children stand with music playing. one takes a step to the left, and the other takes a step to the right. they turn around together, then stop. they try again slowly until they can do the same dance at the same time.
does learning their own dance mean they know every dance?
no. they learned the one they made together. another dance could use something different and need more learning.
write a line one can say when the other gets a part wrong.
let us try that part again slowly. we can do it together.
can the story be happy even when they do not get it right at first?
yes. trying, having a laugh, and learning together can be part of what they enjoy.
i look in a mirror, then look at a photo of myself. i have the same garment on, but the pictures look different. can that happen?
yes. the photo and mirror may show you from different places or with different light. being the same person in the same garment does not make every picture look the same.
say my question using have the same garment on.
i have the same garment on when i look in the mirror and in a photo. can the pictures still look different?
can you make a short made up story about that without giving a long explanation?

a girl looks at a photo her brother took. she says that her face looks different from what she saw in the mirror. he says he took the picture while she was turning to look at the window. she stands in the same place and can see why the picture showed another side of her face.
tell the story in the past.
a girl looked at a photo her brother took. he said he took it while she was turning to the window. she stood in the same place and turned again. the photo showed another side of her face.
did that mean she was a different person?
no. looking different from another side does not make her a different person.
three children have one ball and all want to play. help me write a conversation where they choose what to do without one person keeping it all the time.
i want the ball. so do i. could we send it to each other instead of one person keeping it? yes. you send it to her, she sends it to me, and i send it back to you. then everyone gets a part.
what if one child is still learning to send it back?
the other children could give that child more time and keep the game slow. the group can choose a way to play that works for someone learning too.
say that simply.
the other children can give that child more time. they can keep the game slow while learning together.
write a line the child can say when they need another try.
could i try that again? i am still learning how to send it back.
does a child who needs help have to leave the game?
no. help with one part does not mean they have no part to play. the group can change the game so everyone can join.
now end with them choosing to keep playing slowly.
let us keep it slow for now. we can all play together this way.
i want a note for my desk saying i will return after lunch. do not say i will be back at a specific hour.
i will return after lunch.
add that someone can leave a message if they need me.
i will return after lunch. please leave a message if you need me.
can i say i will read every message right away?
only if you know you can do that. returning after lunch does not tell you how much work will be waiting or when each message can be read.
write the note without saying every message will get a reply at once.
i will return after lunch. please leave a message if you need me, and i will read it when i can.
say what i asked for simply.
you wanted a note about returning after lunch without saying every message would get a reply at once.
what if i choose to stay away for the afternoon too?
then change the note when you can. leaving the old time on the desk may give people information that is no longer true about your plan.
give me a new note for the whole afternoon.
i will be away this afternoon. please leave a message if you need me.
if one person buys a book from another, can the other person say they sell the book?
yes. one person can buy a book, and the other can sell it. the book moves to the person buying it, and money goes to the person giving it.
explain simply.
one buys the book, and the other gets money for it.
write a short conversation at a shop.
i would like to buy this book. yes, this is the price. may i look at the first page before choosing? yes, you can read a little before you buy it.
did the conversation say the book was bought already?
no. the person wants to look before choosing. asking about buying does not mean the money has been given or the book taken.
make the last reply from the person choosing not to buy it today.
thank you. i could look at the book, but i will not buy it today.
use i could look in a short reply.
thank you. i could look at the book, but i will not buy it today.
there is an empty page on my computer screen. does that mean i have never written anything on the computer?
no. an empty page now does not tell us about all your past work. you could have other pages, or you might be starting a new piece of writing.
write a short story where a child thinks the empty page says all the writing is gone, but a parent asks a question first.

a child saw an empty page and said her story was gone. her father asked whether she opened a new page. she said yes, then remembered that the old story was on another page. they looked for it together before choosing what to do next.
keep the story in the past and make it shorter.
a child saw an empty page and thought her story was gone. her father asked about another page. she remembered that the story was there before, so they looked for it.
did they find the old story?
we do not know yet. the last part says they looked for it together.
answer simply.
we do not know yet. they are still looking.
my friends want to begin a game, but i need a minute to put my things away. help me ask them to wait.
could you wait a minute before starting? i need to put my things away.
what if they already started?
you could ask whether you can join after putting your things away: could i join when i am ready? i only need a minute.
i do not know whether it is really one minute. i just need a little time.
then leave out the specific time: could i join when i am ready? i need a little time to put my things away.
give just that request.
could i join when i am ready? i need a little time to put my things away.
why is that better than saying i will be there in one minute if i do not know?
it asks for a little time without saying how many minutes you will need.
say it simply.
you ask for time without choosing a number of minutes.
my friend says turn left at the shop. i am coming from the opposite side of the road from the way they came. could left take me a different way?
yes. if you come from the other side and look the opposite way, left can be a different road.
say it simply.
yes. left changes with the way you are looking.
what question should i ask?
which way should i be coming from when i turn left at the shop?
can they use a place instead of left to help me?
yes, if there is a clear place to name. they could say to take the road that goes to the park, if that is the road they mean.
use to the park in just the road part.
take the road that goes to the park, if that is the road they mean.
write a message asking them which road they mean.
could you tell me which road to take at the shop? i am coming from the other side, so left may not be the same for me.
say my request simply.
ask my friend which road to take, using the place i am coming from.
write a story where a child finds that a tool useful for one toy does not help with another.

a child helps his father fix a toy house. they use a small tool to put one part back in place. later, the child finds another broken toy and brings the same tool. his father asks what is wrong with this toy before they start. they see that the problem is different. the tool that helped with the house is not what they need for this work. they put the toy on the table and think about another way to fix it.
use work in the sentence about the wrong tool.
the tool that helped with the house is not what they need for this work.
does the tool being wrong for this toy mean it cannot help with anything?
no. it helped with the first toy. something can be useful for one task and not useful for another.
make my question simple.
does the tool not helping with this toy mean it cannot help with anything?
what question should they ask before choosing a tool?
what is the problem, and what part needs to be fixed?
does the story say they fixed the other toy?
no. it says that they looked at the problem and thought about what to do next.
my sister says she has a free hour this afternoon. does that mean she has no work to do today?
no. a free hour can be one part of a day that also has work. it does not tell you about every other hour.
can i ask her to help me without saying she has nothing else to do?
yes. you could say: would you have time to help me for a little while this afternoon?
she says she wants that hour for herself.
you can ask about another time if you still want help. free time does not mean someone has already said yes to giving that time to another person.
write a kind reply.
okay. i hope you enjoy your time. is there another day when you might want to help?
can i make it less like another request right away?
yes. keep only the first part: okay. i hope you enjoy your time.
what did you leave out?
the question about helping on another day. the shorter reply does not ask her to choose another time now.
i am writing to someone i have never met. i want the message to be kind without saying it is good to hear from you when they did not write first.
you could begin: hello. i hope your day is going well. then say why you are writing.
that still chooses something about their day. can it just say hello and my reason?
yes. hello can stand alone as a kind start. what is the reason for the message?
i want to ask if they have time to talk about some school work.
hello. would you have time to talk about some school work?
use school work in a simple request.
hello. would you have time to talk about some school work?
add that i do not need an answer today.
hello. would you have time to talk about some school work? you do not need to answer today.
does that say they must answer tomorrow?
no. it says they do not need to answer today, but it does not choose another day.
answer simply.
no. tomorrow is not given in the message.
my friend came over and we talked very little. we each read a book. i still liked having them there.
you can enjoy time together without talking through every minute. did you like the quiet?
we talked very little, but i liked it.
then the quiet was part of what you enjoyed. you can be together while reading, rather than only talking.
say it simply.
you were together while each reading a book. that can still be time you enjoy with a friend.
help me tell them i would like to do that again.
i liked reading with you today. would you like to do that again another day?
should i say they liked it too?
not unless they told you. you can say what you enjoyed and ask whether they want another visit.
they say yes and ask if the same time tomorrow works. i am free then.
then you can say: yes, the same time tomorrow works for me. i will have my book ready.
picoboi, what does right mean?
right can have more than one meaning. it can be the opposite of left, or it can mean correct. what sentence are you looking at?
it says you are right.
in you are right, right is about being correct. it is not about left or right as a place to go.
say it simply.
right in that sentence is about being correct.
now the sentence is turn right at the house.
then right gives the way to turn, opposite left. the context changes which meaning is being used.
if the same word can have more than one meaning, should i only learn one?
learning one can help you start, but you may need more context to understand another use. the words around right tell you which idea is needed in each sentence.
say my question simply.
if one word can have more than one meaning, should i only learn one?
ask me for an example i make myself.
can you write one sentence where right is about being correct?
